description:
In Episode 36 we discuss a variety of subjects from questions received such as why does the 1611 King James Bible contain the apocryphal books?, Is the name of the Messiah Jesus or Yeshua?, are we "once saved, always saved?, what would have happened if Adam and Eve never sinned? And more.

#AdamAndEve,#WalterVeith,#WhatsUpProf

LINKS FOR FURHER STUDY:

The article by Sonica Veith is only available by mail request, please send your request to prof@amazingdiscoveries.co.za

The Distraction Dilemma (Music Series) – Christian Berdahl
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLHY9y2BrWKbjp5hJ3FzXIBTAgO4I1tP5S

Table Talk - Martin Luther
http://www.ntslibrary.com/PDF%20Books/Luther%20Table%20Talk.pdf

Romanism And The Reformation – Henry Grattan Guinness
https://www.whitehorsemedia.com/docs/romanism_and_the_reformation.pdf

0:00 Start
4:29 Why does the original 1611 King James contain the Apocryphal Books?
6:46 Also, is a woman allowed to wear pants or trousers?
7:49 Is a woman allowed to have braided hair either natural or artificial?
9:40 Are beats allowed to be used in making a song  for worship?
11:36 What if a person wants to be baptized but doesn’t want to join an organized church?
14:08 Is it appropriate for him to ask a pastor to baptize him
15:19 Please explain the Name Jesus, is it the name of the Messiah or is it Yeshua?
21:14 Would you teach us please who came up with the "modern theology' of Revelation 
27:00 Please address the “once saved always saved” belief
33:38 What would have happened if Adam and Eve never sinned?
46:50 What is the difference between 7th day Adventist and 7th day REFORM Adventists?
54:47 Can you please explain Tithing?
